title: Research P104 singular-mixing lifetime floor
body:
## Summary

Adds a scoped review of the P104 correction-matrix source-lifetime lower bound in `research/p104-source-lifetime-216-review/`.

For the frozen 104-row correction matrix `C = I - G/2` and widened X-only monotone grammar `G′`, the reviewed counting proof yields `L >= 216`. The package records the finite census, exact source pins, proof audit, limitations, and a local arithmetic verifier. The pinned upstream replay reports 216 for the full singular-mixing model, 219 for the full invertible model, and 234 for the final-frame model.

This is a lower-bound review for the full 104-row correction matrix. It is distinct from the 208-flag endpoint construction. The bound remains below the 333-lifetime decision threshold and does not change the selected frontier or budget.

## Verification

- Exact upstream replay from `743640530229e1821ae11dc104798871272d6f00` with frozen inputs: `PASS_P104_RANK1_MIXER_TOP floor_full=219 floor_final_frame=234 floor_full_singular_mixing=216 pairs_passing_T_final_frame=288 pairs_passing_T_full=414 both_halves_T=0 demo_lifetimes=4974 controls=7 lemma_max_ST=48`.
- Upstream source snapshot hash check: `PASS_UPSTREAM_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT_HASHES 11`.
- `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-source-lifetime-216-review --check-only`: passed metadata and pins.
- `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-source-lifetime-216-review`: passed arithmetic floor recomputation and registered package check.
- `git diff --check`: passed.

## Limits and credit

The written argument and finite replay are scoped to the frozen PR1972/PR1991 paths and `G′` as defined in the package. This does not prove a chronological executable correction, a complete hosting bill, a supplier, an all-size theorem, or a new `κ`. The written proof is not machine checked and no independent human review is claimed. The selected-frontier replay was not run.

Credit Sagar Thakrar, with substantial Claude assistance, for the pinned 216/219/234 theorem and checker; Philippe Van Velzen for the relay grammar and geometry lineage; and Rohan Arun, Chafik Boukhalfa, and Adam Gall for the P104 native-channel lineage. This package records a GPT-6 Luna xhigh (macbook-04) proof review.

## Current overlap

Open PR #3882 submits a source-consuming P104 correction tail. This package audits a separate lower bound for the frozen 104-row correction matrix and constructs no correction word.

## Publication validation

The registered package replay passed on CPython 3.12.3 with `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-source-lifetime-216-review`. The optional `--check-source-history` preflight could not run because this MacBook checkout is shallow and the checker requires full Git history. This package's source manifest pins only files at its exact base commit `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`; it contains no `head:` source pins. Any earlier pending note above refers to the state before this publication-time replay.
